members.name: banking77
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent best describes what the customer is asking about? Pick exactly one.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a new card, or the card won't activate.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open/use an account; can children or teenagers have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a phone/watch wallet with the card, or topping up via Apple/Google Pay.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, can the card be used at ATMs.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: how it works, how to turn it on, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: After a bank transfer (in either direction) the customer's balance hasn't changed / the transfer isn't showing in the account; also 'how long does a UK transfer take, it isn't showing'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited a cheque or cash but the balance hasn't updated / deposit not showing.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, or the beneficiary is not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer/payment they made (e.g. sent to wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Only about which merchants or businesses accept the card.
criteria.card_arrival: Card ordered but not received yet; tracking the card that was sent.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, express/fast-tracked delivery, delivery by a date, how the card will be delivered.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the account in the app; adding a card they already have, making a received card show in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: Vague 'my card doesn't work / isn't working / didn't work / didn't go through', e.g. in a shop or in several places. Not at an ATM (card not working at an ATM is declined_cash_withdrawal).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Fees charged for using the card or on card payments; also vague complaints about hidden fees or 'why so many fees / why was I charged a fee'.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A payment or purchase the customer didn't make or doesn't recognise, including 'there is a payment I don't recognise' / 'I didn't make this payment' even without the word card.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase abroad/in foreign currency.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM; ATM withdrawal fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer didn't make.
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised/stolen/copied and someone else may be using the card (fraudulent use), card not physically lost.
criteria.country_support: Which countries are supported; using the service or having the card sent/mailed to a given country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment or purchase explicitly 'declined' or 'not accepted'/'rejected'.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: Couldn't get cash: an ATM withdrawal was declined or not authorised, the ATM wouldn't give cash, or the card won't work at an ATM.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was explicitly declined or rejected, or the customer was told the transfer is not possible/not allowed.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unrecognised or unauthorised direct debit; ALSO vague messages about an unknown/unauthorised/mistaken 'charge' ('I have an unknown charge', 'unauthorised charge', 'dispute a charge') that do not call it a payment or purchase.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions on disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many cards).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change personal details (name, address, info) on the account.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rates are, where to find them, how they are determined.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small extra amount like £1, $1 or €1 charged / on the statement / pending, even when the customer doesn't recognise it.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed, gave an error or didn't go through, or the customer simply can't make a transfer (without saying it was declined).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding/exchange.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Only questions about the card PIN: PIN not received, where to find the PIN, setting the PIN.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/second card for the account.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a (non-disposable) virtual card; where to find the virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card has been lost or stolen; found a lost card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen; using the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Any request for an actual physical card: how to order/get one (even if they already have a virtual card), its cost or whether it's free, where cards ship.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot passcode/login code; resetting the app passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is still pending or hasn't gone through yet; 'when will my payment go through?'.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending / in progress.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending, taking long, or the customer isn't sure it went through.
criteria.pending_transfer: The message says a transfer is still 'pending' / in progress (in either direction; also some 'money sent to me not visible yet'). Any transfer described as pending goes here.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong entries; unblock the account/card.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money; can others send me money; receiving a salary/payment.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant hasn't appeared in the account.
criteria.request_refund: How to request/get a refund for a purchase.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned to the account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa/Mastercard, credit cards) and currencies are supported, e.g. which cards can be used to top up.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or cheque; how to deposit cash/cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined or didn't go through.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts or frequency; maximum top-up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up appeared to complete but the money then disappeared/was reverted from the balance (no card mentioned).
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card, or problems topping up with a card (e.g. tried to top up with my card and the money is gone).
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account (add funds by bank transfer).
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Customer sent money and the recipient (a named person, landlord, friend, family, retailer) hasn't received it; also complaints that a transfer they sent days ago is taking too long or still hasn't gone through/been completed.
criteria.transfer_timing: General question about how long bank transfers take or when transferred money will be available, without saying a transfer is pending or not showing (not about card payments).
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing / can't verify identity.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed; how long verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of funds; where money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used to top up; can't find the verification code for a top-up or card transfer.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification / personal information is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM dispensed less/wrong amount of cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to an ATM cash withdrawal abroad.
